attributes.board_name: Indiana Occupational Therapy Committee (Medical Licensing Board of Indiana / Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by the Committee or sponsored by AOTA/AOTA-approved providers, NBCOT, or IOTA/IOTA-approved providers. At least 9 hours Category I (courses, workshops, seminars, symposia, approved home study/online/audio/video, accredited college courses on OT). Max 9 hours Category II: publications (max 5), preparing to teach an accredited OT course (max 6), Level I/II fieldwork supervision (1 h per 32 h, max 6), in-service seminars, officer/committee chair roles, supervising pre-OT observation hours, research. All 18 hours may be distance learning.
rules.new_licensee_rule: License valid less than 12 months at renewal: no CE; valid 12–24 months: 9 hours; full 24 months: 18 hours.
rules.audit_note: Certify completion at renewal; keep verification 3 years after the last renewal date and present it at the Committee's request.
rules.notes: Licenses expire December 31 of even-numbered years; renewal fee $100. Rule package LSA #25-329 (effective Feb 11, 2026) added CE for reinstatement of licenses expired 3+ years; the 18-hour renewal requirement is unchanged.
rules.rule_quote: Sec. 3. (a) During each two (2) year license period, an occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant must complete at least eighteen (18) hours of continuing competency of which at least nine (9) hours must be in category I courses.
